DIL SE FOR ZEHNISH
With love • Hamesha ke liye ❤

Meri Pyaari Zehnish,

Main nahi jaanta ki lafz kabhi wo sab bayan kar paayenge jo main tumhare liye mehsoos karta hoon, lekin aaj dil ki har baat tumhare aage sach-sach rakhna chahta hoon.

Jab maine tumhe 11 July (Monday) ko pehli baar dekha tha, usi ek nazar mein mujhe tumse be-inteha pyaar ho gaya. Mujhe andaza bhi nahi tha ki tum meri zindagi ka sabse anmol aur khoobsurat hissa ban jaogi.

Us din ke baad se main tumhara ek one-sided lover ban kar reh gaya — ek aisa aashiq jo bina kisi umeed ya shart ke, sirf dil se tumhari khushi aur salamati ki dua maangta hai.

Main jaanta hoon Zehnish, kabhi kabhi main over-possessive ho jata hoon… Aur uske liye main dil ki gehraiyon se tumse sorry bolta hoon. Mera irada kabhi tumhe baandhna ya uncomfortable karna nahi tha, bas tumhe khone ke darr aur be-panah fikar ki wajah se aisa ho jata hai.

Tum meri zindagi ki sabse pyari khushi ho. Chahe waqt kaisa bhi guzre, meri respect aur mera pyaar tumhare liye hamesha utna hi paak rahega.

Dil ki gehraiyon se, Yours Forever ❤

Dil Ki Sacchai

A Sincere Apology & Promise 🤍

🕊️ Dil Se Sorry

I’m Truly Sorry for Being Over-Possessive…

Jab dil kisi se behisaab mohabbat karta hai, toh kabhi kabhi be-panah fikar aur khone ka darr over-possessiveness ban kar nikal aata hai. Main jaanta hoon meri is aadat ne shayad kabhi tumhe uncomfortable mehsoos karaya ho.

Uske liye main dil ki gehraiyon se tumse maafi maangta hoon, Zehnish. Mera maqsad kabhi tumhari azaadi ya muskurahat par bandish lagana nahi tha.
